name: Sido Muncul (PT Industri Jamu Dan Farmasi Sido Muncul Tbk)

deployments_detail.company: Sido Muncul (PT Industri Jamu Dan Farmasi Sido Muncul Tbk)
deployments_detail.use: Cloud-native GenAI/RAG inference infrastructure for the HerbalPedia platform — containerized, GPU-enabled architecture with separated tiers (user access/traffic distribution layer, application front/back-end layer, and a dedicated workload for GenAI inference and RAG) provisioned and managed on cloud to run the AI assistant in production at scale. [ICS Compute (cloud infrastructure/deployment), redpumpkin.AI (application)]

deployments_detail.company: Sido Muncul (PT Industri Jamu Dan Farmasi Sido Muncul Tbk)
deployments_detail.use: SiHerbie ('Your Smart Herbal Assistant') — consumer-facing generative-AI conversational assistant that answers health questions and gives standardized/halal herbal-product recommendations, disease explanations, scientific evidence and dosage guidance. Launched with the Sido HerbalPedia portal on 23 April 2026 as part of the company's 75th anniversary. [redpumpkin.AI (application), ICS Compute (cloud infra), AWS]

deployments_detail.company: Sido Muncul (PT Industri Jamu Dan Farmasi Sido Muncul Tbk)
deployments_detail.use: Sido HerbalPedia — AI-powered herbal/health knowledge platform (sidoherbalpedia.com) built on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) plus generative-AI models grounded in a curated herbal literature database (66 medicinal plants at launch, 24 more in development, with bioactive compounds, clinical-trial results and mechanisms of action), designed to give evidence-based answers rather than hallucinated responses. [redpumpkin.AI, ICS Compute, AWS (RAG + GenAI)]

deployments_detail.company: Sido Muncul (PT Industri Jamu Dan Farmasi Sido Muncul Tbk)
deployments_detail.use: GenAI assistant build/delivery for Sido Muncul's herbal wellness products — described by the vendor as a real product in production (not a pilot/PoC), delivered by an Indonesian agentic-AI consultancy in partnership with AWS Indonesia. [redpumpkin.AI (agentic AI, AWS Bedrock infrastructure, AWS AI Competency), AWS Indonesia]
